Design reviews you can measure

This fixture is a small, accessible page used to verify that Visual Director reports clean results when nothing is wrong.

Open the 3D scene

  • Measured

    Layout, assets, accessibility and motion are read from a real browser.

  • Repeatable

    Every pass writes the same report shape so passes can be compared.

  • Honest

    Checks that cannot run are reported as skipped, never as passed.

Patterns that are not defects

A line-clamped summary is a deliberate, visibly marked truncation: the card shows two lines and an ellipsis, the full description stays in the document for assistive technology, and the detail page repeats it in full. Visual Director reports it as information, like a single-line ellipsis, and never as clipped content that hides meaning from readers.
